# Lab 12.11: Explainable AI

## What We Are Going to Do
Explain individual predictions and the whole model with Shapley-based feature attributions.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Explain single predictions.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT predicted_income_bracket, top_feature_attributions, baseline_prediction_value
FROM ML.EXPLAIN_PREDICT(MODEL lab12.income_bt,
  (SELECT * FROM lab12.v_income LIMIT 5),
  STRUCT(3 AS top_k_features));</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Each row lists the 3 features that pushed its prediction up or down the most.

2. **[SQL] Global explanation.** The model was trained with `enable_global_explain = TRUE`.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Local explanation | Top features per row |
| Global explanation | Average impact per feature |
| Feature importance | Gain, weight and cover for trees |
| Top driver | Usually marital status or education |
